'''Baylis Archan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an apprentice to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sha Koon]].

==Biography==
[[File:DeathOfBaylisArchan-STD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Archan's body is cradled by his Master.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Baylis Archan was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and taken to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] as an infant. Entering into the [[Jedi academy|Temple academy]], [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] Archan was encouraged to develop his naturally heightened [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] during his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] there. After [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduating]] from the academy, Archan was chosen by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sha Koon]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="STD" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Archan and his Master led the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] against the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], taking up the rank of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]]. Deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Giju/Legends|Giju]] to lead the ongoing [[Battle of Giju (Clone Wars)|battle]] there, Archan and the men he fought alongside [[Death/Legends|died]] in combat, leaving Koon to bring the battle to a successful conclusion. Holding him in her arms as he died, Koon sensed his passing through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; her connection to Archan was very strong, as she would feel a similar pain when her uncle, the esteemed [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] member [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], was killed during the first stages of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="STD" />
